# Test fixtures

`evo_dump.json`, `laundry_dump.json`, `hw70_dump.json`, `ref_dump.json`, `devices_page.json` and
`login.json` are taken from [and7ey/haier_evo](https://github.com/and7ey/haier_evo) (`tests/fixtures`,
MIT license): real descriptions the Haier Evo cloud returned for users' devices, anonymized there
(MACs, serial numbers, IPs, e-mails and links replaced).

- `evo_dump.json`: water heater ES80V-F7 and three air conditioners AS25S2SF2FA-B, with the
  "Мой дом" page (`backend_data`).
- `laundry_dump.json`: washing machines HW60-BP12929AE and HW90-B14367U1, dryer HD80-A2367U1.
- `hw70_dump.json`: washing machine HW70-BP12337U1.
- `ref_dump.json`: refrigerator C4F640CWU1.

`snapshot.json` is generated by `tests/test_snapshot.py` from the integration's own output.
